products.name: Challenge Proxy
products.tagline: Unified attestation challenge aggregation across providers
products.description: Fetch attestation challenges from multiple upstream providers through a single REST API. Challenge Proxy normalizes different protocols and formats, handles provider failover, and caches results — so your SDK can focus on executing the VM and assembling tokens.
products.summary: Multi-source challenge fetching with circuit breaking, fallback, and caching.
products.keyBenefit: One API for all upstream challenge sources, with automatic failover.
features: Unified REST API across multiple upstream providers
Automatic provider failover with circuit breaker and stale cache
Per-client API key authentication and usage billing
Built-in rate limiting with sliding-window counters
Redis or in-memory caching with configurable TTL
benefits: No need to maintain fragile integrations with each upstream
Graceful degradation when a provider is unavailable
Per-customer usage tracking and audit trail
Drop-in replacement for homegrown challenge-fetching code
useCases: Server-side attestation for content and data pipelines
Multi-source token generation with unified interface
Multi-product teams sharing a single challenge infrastructure

products.name: Attest API
products.tagline: End-to-end attestation token generation with verification
products.description: A production-grade API for generating attestation tokens. Executes BotGuard challenges via residential proxies and returns tokens verified against target endpoints in real time.
products.keyBenefit: Get tokens that work on the first try, every time.
features: Real BotGuard challenge execution via residential proxies
Verified against target endpoints before delivery
benefits: Tokens accepted on first request — verified in CI
Handles proxy rotation and cookie management
Drop-in SDK or plain HTTP API
useCases: API access automation for supported services
